scientific_question: Can the accepted native UCOPE five-UAV source justify re-entry through one geometry-bound learned actor operation that uses only each actor's existing local observation plus its current last velocity and hold state, while preserving the B02 per-agent PPO credit convention? Assess this concrete candidate: replace the first dense actor encoding by a parameter-matched typed relation encoder over the existing 20 user rows (relative dx, dy, normalized SINR) and 10 other-UAV rows (relative dx, dy, dz, normalized SINR), using shared row maps and fixed-count pooling, then fuse that context with a residual encoding of all original 108 actor inputs before the unchanged recurrent velocity head. It must use no persistent IDs, global diagnostics, entity positions, new masks, ground-base metadata, or changed reward/action path. Compare it with an equally exposed, competent, parameter/optimizer-matched generic dense actor consuming the same 108 inputs under the same primitive velocity host and B02 per-agent clipping. Decide whether this is a meaning-complete MGTAP ground-geometry discriminator whose learned actor differences can change legal velocity decisions, PPO credit, or native team service through the existing channel, interference, SINR and greedy association path; if not, return the precise source/scientific yield and retain the parked family.

constraints: This is source inspection and one direction-level Convergence question only: zero model construction, simulation, profiling, training, evaluation, scientific import, implementation, launch and result-bearing exposure.

Read every listed source and document at the fixed full SHA d726acf63f8db47bd2e93e43cac8bbd27529d8ad. Do not substitute a moving branch, local current tree, web mirror, synthetic adapter, unlisted path or pasted source copy; do not alter UCOPE source.

Trace the accepted native facts: five UAVs, 50 uniformly placed ground users, 1000 m area, heights 50-150 m, 30 m/s velocity scaling, 256 one-second steps, free-space/vectorized channel, current own position, 20 SINR-ranked local user rows and 10 SINR-ranked other-UAV rows, normalized SINR, time, last sent velocity and remaining hold. Ranked slots are not persistent entity IDs.

The critic receives separate global state and commitments; global diagnostics, local indices, entity_positions and ground-base metadata are not actor inputs. The default ground base [500,500,30] has no accepted actor or reward binding and cannot be introduced as treatment information.

The legal actor action remains a three-dimensional normalized velocity, scaled and clipped by the native environment. Movement updates distance-dependent channels, interference, SINR eligibility and capacity-limited greedy one-user-per-UAV association; global_reward remains 0.7*connected_users/50 + 0.3*mean normalized SINR quality, with each agent receiving global_reward/5 and the learner summing rewards_dict to native team return.

The candidate relation operation must consume only existing actor inputs, use no persistent IDs, privileged global state, new mask, changed entity membership, new reward, assignment action or synthetic service law, and retain the full raw 108-input path so generic information is not cut. It must be a learned geometry-conditioned actor operation, not a renamed coordinate, redundant scalar distance or rank-map port.

Hold the recurrent history, five-agent membership, channel and association path, action distribution and B02 common per-agent PPO clipping fixed. If a future comparison uses the B02 host, both arms must use the same primitive velocity/hold mode; do not relabel opening duration, movement magnitude, FSD renewal, value sharing or generic optimizer sensitivity as the geometry treatment. Prefer the no-duration primitive G mode when isolating the geometry factor, and require Pro to state the choice.

Retain a competent same-information generic comparator with equal optimization, tuning/selection exposure and parameter budget. A weaker comparator or treatment-only information is invalid. If exact parameter matching requires width changes, state the mapping and preserve the same recurrent/action/credit path.

MGTAP B03's allocation-coordinate family remains parked unless the complete decision supplies a new source-backed native-value re-entry. Do not reopen historical C objects, alter lifecycle, priority, fusion or investment, count UAV entry, choose code, budget or execution, or create a Portfolio decision.

The accepted known per-arm work law is init + 131072*c_env_actor + 1024*c_update + 8192*c_eval + publication; relation-branch and parameter-matching overhead remain unknown.
